title: German federal ordinary budget, December 1923–June 1924
source: Statistisches Reichsamt, reproduced by Young (1925) and Sargent (1982)
series: ordinary revenue, of which taxes, and ordinary expenditure, million gold marks
license: Sargent (1982), in R. E. Hall (ed.), Inflation: Causes and Effects (NBER, 1982): '© 1982 by The National Bureau of Economic Research. All rights reserved.' The series is a factual transcription of official German statistics (Statistisches Reichsamt, through Young 1925), with full credit to Sargent, the volume and the NBER.
notes: Sargent Table G5, p.83, citing Young vol.1 p.422 and Wirtschaft und Statistik. Ordinary federal accounts only; excludes an inference about the complete consolidated public-sector balance. November expenditure cell is blank and omitted. December deficit and February deficit are preserved, against an over-literal reading of the surrounding narrative. The column taxes_million_goldmark (added 2026-10-21) is G5's 'Of Which Taxes Yielded'; its December and January values equal Bresciani-Turroni's (p. 356, row bt_receipts2 of weimar_facts). The copy read is listed under documents (with its SHA-256); the rows hold no quotations, so data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py does not read this snapshot.
